include_in_primary_estimate.description: Indicates whether the proposal should be included in the primary estimate, if this flag should be updated.

is_primary.description:
Indicates whether the proposal should become primary.
Only one primary proposal can exist in a project.

post.summary: Create line items and line item groups in bulk to the Project

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

name.description: Display name of the line item.

group_id.description: Line item group ID. Omit or leave empty to use the default group.

cost_item.description: Cost item associated with the line item. Provide custom pricing or omit to use a generic cost item based on type. When provided, the entire cost item is replaced (no partial updates). At least one of `cost_item.unit` or `type` must be provided so the line item's measurement basis is determined.

name.description: Display name of the cost item.

unit_labor.description: Labor time per unit, in the unit specified by labor_time_unit (e.g. minutes when labor_time_unit is MINUTES).

is_untaxed.description: Whether the item is excluded from tax.

id.description: Catalog item ID to link to an existing cost item. Omit or leave empty to create a new custom cost item from the provided fields.

symbol_id.description: Symbol ID for takeoff. Built-in: circle, square, empty. Custom: numeric document ID string.

parts.description: Sub-items (parts) of an assembly cost item. Empty for non-assembly cost items. On create, replaces the parts list copied from any referenced catalog item. Only valid when `type` is `Assembly` — providing parts with any other type is rejected with 400.

items.description: Cost item sub-item (part of an assembly).

name.description: Display name of the cost item.

unit_labor.description: Labor time per unit, in the unit specified by labor_time_unit (e.g. minutes when labor_time_unit is MINUTES).

is_untaxed.description: Whether the item is excluded from tax.

labor_factor.description: Labor difficulty factor applied to the cost item.

quantity.description: Quantity from the estimating table (manual entry). Updated when using estimating or takeoff tab.

tag.description: Optional tag for filtering or grouping.

type.description: How the line item quantity is measured (count, linear, area, etc.).

takeoff_quantity.description: Quantity measured in the takeoff tab (2D drawing and 3D model measurements combined). Read-only.

updated_at.description: The date and time when the line item was last updated.
